# Cephron LifeSciences

> Cephron LifeSciences is an ISO 9001:2015 certified PCD (Propaganda Cum Distribution) pharma franchise and pharmaceutical distribution company based in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded in July 2025, it supplies WHO-GMP certified medicines and offers monopoly-based franchise opportunities with complete marketing support across India.

## About

- **Business type:** PCD pharma franchise and pharmaceutical distribution
- **Founded:** July 2025
- **Certification:** ISO 9001:2015; products sourced from WHO-GMP certified facilities

## Leadership

- Mr. Mohd Ahmad Hashmi — Founder & Director

## Services

- **PCD Pharma Franchise:** Monopoly territorial rights, complete marketing support (MR bags, visual aids, brochures, product samples), low investment, high returns.
- **Pharmaceutical Distribution:** Reliable supply of quality medicines and medical products to pharmacies, hospitals, and healthcare providers.

## Products

Tablets, capsules, syrups, injections, ointments, drops, nutraceuticals, herbal products, medical devices, and healthcare consumables. Therapeutic areas include general medicine, pediatrics, chronic care, nutraceuticals, and medical devices.

## Franchise Eligibility

Open to medical representatives, first-time entrepreneurs, and existing pharma distributors. Requires a valid Drug License and GST Registration. Basic pharma marketing knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.
